Columns of the Opta stats and xmetrics tables the SPM steps read

Source: R/spm_opta.R
dot-spm_opta_stats_keep_cols.Rd

Steps 05 (SPM fit) and 07 (seasonal ratings) read only these columns of the ~289-column player-match stats table and the ~69-column xmetrics table. Step 02 writes a narrowed copy (02_opta_stats_narrow.rds) so those steps never deserialize the full ~9.5GB stats table, which put step 05 at 15.6-15.8GB of the 16GB runner and killed it on 2026-10-10 (panna#87). Readers of the stats table: aggregate_opta_stats() (every column in .get_opta_col_mapping(), plus match_id, player_name, position), .ensure_player_id(), .spm_league_shares() (a competition column and a minutes column), and step 07's season filters (season). Readers of xmetrics: .aggregate_xmetrics_for_spm() and the chain-feature blocks in 05/07. tests/testthat/test-spm-opta-helpers.R checks that each reader gives identical output on the narrowed table.

Usage

.spm_opta_stats_keep_cols(nm)

.spm_xmetrics_keep_cols(nm)

Arguments

nm

Column names of the table being narrowed.

Value

The subset of nm to keep, in nm's order.
